messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need to finalise SLA demarcation across hosted / dedicated / private. Are we calling this 'zoning' or something else?

sam: zoning sounds good. main questions: who owns latency SLOs vs availability vs data residency guarantees?

tina: For product planning it'd help to map each capability to owner: control plane (redwood), data plane (customer), ops (redwood SRE) etc.

kevin: Agree. Also need clarity on upgrade choreography: who can force model rollbacks in private vs hosted?

ashok: From SRE POV telemetry must be available for availability SLOs. Private installs often block metrics. How do we handle error budgets when we can't see metrics?

maria: Proposed pattern: define three SLA zones — "managed" (hosted), "committed" (dedicated), "self-hosted" (private). Each zone has a responsibility matrix.

josh: Example responsibility matrix snippet:

```
{
  "zone": "committed",
  "control_plane_owner": "redwood",
  "data_plane_owner": "redwood/customer-shared",
  "sla": "99.9",
  "metric_visibility": "partial (agent + sampling)"
}
```

priya: For private installs we offer an "observability bridge" option: lightweight metrics agent that ships to customer telemetry or to us depending on contract. Key rotation stays customer-managed unless they enable KMS integration.

ashok: OK — if we can't see metrics we should fall back to blackbox health checks (ingress/egress pings) and rely on customer certs for auditing.

sam: How about fallbacks when a hosted model is unavailable? We should standardise a fallback order: same-region replica -> cheaper model -> degraded response with header meta.

tina: Add a requirement that rollback authority differs: redwood can auto-rollback hosted; dedicated needs joint ops approval; private is customer-controlled unless contract specifies otherwise.

maria: Decision (tentative): adopt zone taxonomy + responsibility matrix + observability bridge as opt-in. Create RFC to pin specifics: metric sets, fallback sequences, rollback authority.

josh: Action: I'll draft the RFC with matrices, sample policies, and a companion checklist for sales/security. Owner: @josh. Due EOW.

priya: I'll own private-install observability agent spec. Will prototype env vars + minimal telemetry bundle.

ashok: SRE will define fallback health checks and recommended blackbox probes. Owner: @ashok.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: infra-catalogue v2 -> staging at 2026-03-22T09:00Z :rocket:

maria: Thanks everyone. We'll sync in sync-up Friday to close gaps. :thumbsup:
